001.name: Bulbasaur
001.text: It can go for days without eating a single morsel. In the bulb on its back, it stores energy.

002.name: Ivysaur
002.text: The bulb on its back grows by drawing energy. It gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.

003.name: Venusaur
003.text: The flower on its back catches the sun's rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.

004.name: Charmander
004.text: The flame at the tip of its tail makes a sound as it burns. You can only hear it in quiet places.

005.name: Charmeleon
005.text: Tough fights could excite this POKéMON. When excited, it may blow out bluish-white flames.

006.name: Charizard
006.text: When expelling a blast of super hot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

007.name: Squirtle
007.text: Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.

008.name: Wartortle
008.text: When tapped, this POKéMON will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

009.name: Blastoise
009.text: Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.

010.name: Caterpie
010.text: If you touch the feeler on top of its head, it will release a horrible stink to protect itself.

011.name: Metapod
011.text: Hardens its shell to protect itself. However, a large impact may cause it to pop out of its shell.

012.name: Butterfree
012.text: Its wings, covered with poisonous powders, repel water. This allows it to fly in the rain.

013.name: Weedle
013.text: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

014.name: Kakuna
014.text: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

015.name: Beedrill
015.text: It has 3 poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

016.name: Pidgey
016.text: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

017.name: Pidgeotto
017.text: This POKéMON is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

018.name: Pidgeot
018.text: This POKéMON flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

019.name: Rattata
019.text: Will chew on any-thing with its fangs. If you see one, it is certain that 40 more live in the area.

020.name: Raticate
020.text: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

021.name: Spearow
021.text: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its ter-ritory.

022.name: Fearow
022.text: A POKéMON that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

023.name: Ekans
023.text: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

024.name: Arbok
024.text: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

025.name: Pikachu
025.text: It keeps its tail raised to monitor its surroundings. If you yank its tail, it will try to bite you.

026.name: Raichu
026.text: When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.

027.name: Sandshrew
027.text: Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.

028.name: Sandslash
028.text: It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.

029.name: Nidoran F
029.text: A mild-mannered POKéMON that does not like to fight. Beware, its small horns secrete venom.

030.name: Nidorina
030.text: When resting deep in its burrow, its thorns always retract. This is proof that it is relaxed.

031.name: Nidoqueen
031.text: Tough scales cover the sturdy body of this POKéMON. It appears that the scales grow in cycles.

032.name: Nidoran M
032.text: Its large ears are always kept upright. If it senses danger, it will attack with a poisonous sting.

033.name: Nidorino
033.text: Its horns contain venom. If they are stabbed into an enemy, the impact makes the poison leak out.

034.name: Nidoking
034.text: Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle. Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.

035.name: Clefairy
035.text: Adored for their cute looks and playfulness. They are thought to be rare, as they do not appear often.

036.name: Clefable
036.text: They appear to be very protective of their own world. It is a kind of fairy, rarely seen by people.

037.name: Vulpix
037.text: Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.

038.name: Ninetales
038.text: According to an enduring legend, 9 noble saints were united and reincarnated as this POKéMON.

039.name: Jigglypuff
039.text: Uses its alluring eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.

040.name: Wigglytuff
040.text: Its body is full of elasticity. By inhaling deeply, it can continue to inflate itself without limit.

041.name: Zubat
041.text: Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for ob-jects in its way.

042.name: Golbat
042.text: It attacks in a stealthy manner, without warning. Its sharp fangs are used to bite and suck blood.

043.name: Oddish
043.text: It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds. If you try to yank it out of the ground, it shrieks horribly.

044.name: Gloom
044.text: Smells incredibly foul! However, around 1 out of 1,000 people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

045.name: Vileplume
045.text: Flaps its broad flower petals to scatter its poisonous pollen. The flapping sound is very loud.

046.name: Paras
046.text: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

047.name: Parasect
047.text: The bug host is drained of energy by the mushrooms on its back. They appear to do all the thinking.

048.name: Venonat
048.text: Its large eyes act as radars. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

049.name: Venomoth
049.text: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

050.name: Diglett
050.text: It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.

051.name: Dugtrio
051.text: A team of triplets that can burrow over 60 MPH. Due to this, some people think it's an earthquake.

052.name: Meowth
052.text: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can't stop from picking them up.

053.name: Persian
053.text: The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.

054.name: Psyduck
054.text: Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but it is not known if it intends to do so.

055.name: Golduck
055.text: Its slim and long limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swim-ming gracefully in lakes.

056.name: Mankey
056.text: An agile POKéMON that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

057.name: Primeape
057.text: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

058.name: Growlithe
058.text: A POKéMON with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.

059.name: Arcanine
059.text: A legendary POKéMON in China. Many people are charmed by its grace and beauty while running.

060.name: Poliwag
060.text: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.

061.name: Poliwhirl
061.text: Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.

062.name: Poliwrath
062.text: Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake champion swimmers.

063.name: Abra
063.text: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.

064.name: Kadabra
064.text: Many odd things happen if this POKéMON is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backwards.

065.name: Alakazam
065.text: A POKéMON that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns--that's why this POKéMON is smart.

066.name: Machop
066.text: Very powerful in spite of its small size. Its mastery of many types of martial arts makes it very tough.

067.name: Machoke
067.text: The belt around its waist holds back its energy. Without it, this POKéMON would be unstoppable.

068.name: Machamp
068.text: One arm alone can move mountains. Using all four arms, this POKéMON fires off awesome punches.

069.name: Bellsprout
069.text: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny insects with its vines and devours them.

070.name: Weepinbell
070.text: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is melted inside by strong acids.

071.name: Victreebel
071.text: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is melted in a day, bones and all.

072.name: Tentacool
072.text: It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.

073.name: Tentacruel
073.text: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.

074.name: Geodude
074.text: Commonly found near mountain trails, etc. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.

075.name: Graveler
075.text: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.

076.name: Golem
076.text: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it's exposed to air.

077.name: Ponyta
077.text: Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.

078.name: Rapidash
078.text: Just loves to run. If it sees some-thing faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.

079.name: Slowpoke
079.text: Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.

080.name: Slowbro
080.text: Lives lazily by the sea. If the SHELLDER on its tail comes off, it becomes a SLOWPOKE again.

081.name: Magnemite
081.text: It is born with the ability to defy gravity. It floats in air on powerful electro-magnetic waves.

082.name: Magneton
082.text: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the tem-perature by 3.6F degrees within 3,300 feet.

083.name: Farfetchd
083.text: Lives where reedy plants grow. They are rarely seen, so it's thought their numbers are decreasing.

084.name: Doduo
084.text: Its short wings make flying dif-ficult. Instead, this POKéMON runs at high speed on developed legs.

085.name: Dodrio
085.text: One of DODUO's 2 heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 MPH in prairies.

086.name: Seel
086.text: Loves freezing cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid cli-mate of around 14F degrees.

087.name: Dewgong
087.text: Its entire body is a snowy-white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

088.name: Grimer
088.text: Made of hardened sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.

089.name: Muk
089.text: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration, it lost its sense of smell.

090.name: Shellder
090.text: The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.

091.name: Cloyster
091.text: For protection, it uses its harder-than-diamonds shell. It also shoots spikes from the shell.

092.name: Gastly
092.text: Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape as it appears to be made of a gas.

093.name: Haunter
093.text: By licking, it saps the victim's life. It causes shaking that won't stop until the victim's demise.

094.name: Gengar
094.text: A GENGAR is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.

095.name: Onix
095.text: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by DIGLETTs.

096.name: Drowzee
096.text: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it has eaten in the past.

097.name: Hypno
097.text: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

098.name: Krabby
098.text: Its pincers are superb weapons. They sometimes break off during battle, but they grow back fast.

099.name: Kingler
099.text: One claw grew massively and as hard as steel. It has 10,000-HP strength. However, it is too heavy.

100.name: Voltorb
100.text: It is said to camouflage itself as a # BALL. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.

101.name: Electrode
101.text: Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.

102.name: Exeggcute
102.text: The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be 6 heads for it to maintain balance.

103.name: Exeggutor
103.text: Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the 3 heads thinks about whatever it likes.

104.name: Cubone
104.text: Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.

105.name: Marowak
105.text: Small and weak, this POKéMON is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.

106.name: Hitmonlee
106.text: When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on im-pact and destroys its enemy.

107.name: Hitmonchan
107.text: Punches in cork-screw fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall in the same way as a drill.

108.name: Lickitung
108.text: Its tongue spans almost 7 feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.

109.name: Koffing
109.text: In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!

110.name: Weezing
110.text: It lives and grows by absorbing dust, germs and poison gases that are contained in toxic waste and garbage.

111.name: Rhyhorn
111.text: A POKéMON with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won't stop running until it falls asleep.

112.name: Rhydon
112.text: Walks on its hind legs. Shows signs of intelligence. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.

113.name: Chansey
113.text: A gentle and kind-hearted POKéMON that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured POKéMON.

114.name: Tangela
114.text: Its identity is obscured by masses of thick, blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.

115.name: Kangaskhan
115.text: Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won't run from any fight to keep its young protected.

116.name: Horsea
116.text: If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.

117.name: Seadra
117.text: Touching the back fin causes numb-ness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.

118.name: Goldeen
118.text: When it is time for them to lay eggs, they can be seen swimming up rivers and falls in large groups.

119.name: Seaking
119.text: It is the male's job to make a nest by carving out boulders in a stream using the horn on its head.

120.name: Staryu
120.text: As long as the center section is unharmed, it can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.

121.name: Starmie
121.text: The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in 7 colors.

122.name: Mr Mime
122.text: Always practices its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn't.

123.name: Scyther
123.text: Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The move-ment looks like that of a ninja.

124.name: Jynx
124.text: Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.

125.name: Electabuzz
125.text: If a major power outage occurs, it is certain that this POKéMON has eaten electricity at a power plant.

126.name: Magmar
126.text: Born in an active volcano. Its body is always cloaked in flames, so it looks like a big ball of fire.

127.name: Pinsir
127.text: Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can't move if it's cold, so it lives in warm places.

128.name: Tauros
128.text: A rowdy POKéMON with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won't stop until it hits something.

129.name: Magikarp
129.text: Famous for being very unreliable. It can be found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers and shallow puddles.

130.name: Gyarados
130.text: Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.

131.name: Lapras
131.text: A gentle soul that can read the minds of people. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.

132.name: Ditto
132.text: When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost perfect copy of its oppo-nent.

133.name: Eevee
133.text: Its genetic code is unstable, so it could evolve in a variety of ways. There are only a few alive.

134.name: Vaporeon
134.text: Its cell structure is similar to water molecules. It will melt away and become invis-ible in water.

135.name: Jolteon
135.text: A sensitive POKéMON that easily becomes sad or angry. Every time its mood changes, it charges power.

136.name: Flareon
136.text: It has a flame chamber inside its body. It inhales, then blows out fire that is over 3,000F degrees.

137.name: Porygon
137.text: The only POKéMON people anticipate can fly into space. None has managed the feat yet, however.

138.name: Omanyte
138.text: An ancient POKéMON that was recovered from a fossil. It swims by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.

139.name: Omastar
139.text: Sharp beaks ring its mouth. Its shell was too big for it to move freely, so it became extinct.

140.name: Kabuto
140.text: A POKéMON that was recovered from a fossil. It uses the eyes on its back while hiding on the sea floor.

141.name: Kabutops
141.text: A slim and fast swimmer. It slices its prey with its sharp sickles and drinks the body fluids.

142.name: Aerodactyl
142.text: A savage POKéMON that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.

143.name: Snorlax
143.text: Will eat anything, even if the food happens to be a little moldy. It never gets an upset stomach.

144.name: Articuno
144.text: A legendary bird POKéMON. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.

145.name: Zapdos
145.text: This legendary bird POKéMON is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.

146.name: Moltres
146.text: A legendary bird POKéMON. As it flaps its flaming wings, even the night sky will turn red.

147.name: Dratini
147.text: The existence of this mythical POKéMON was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.

148.name: Dragonair
148.text: According to a witness, its body was surrounded by a strange aura that gave it a mystical look.

149.name: Dragonite
149.text: It is said that this POKéMON lives somewhere in the sea and that it flies. However, it is only a rumor.

150.name: Mewtwo
150.text: Its DNA is almost the same as MEW's. However, its size and disposition are vastly dif-ferent.

151.name: Mew
151.text: When viewed through a micro-scope, this POKéMON's short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.
